stem: Sugar molecules enter cells through transport proteins.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why transport proteins are required for the movement of sugar molecules, such as glucose and fructose, into cells.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Use the information in Fig. 5.1 to explain how sucrose:

• moves into the companion cell
• moves from the companion cell into the sieve tube element.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Sucrose travels in phloem sieve tubes to sinks.

State two examples of sinks.
